SAUDI ARABIA - AVOID NON-ESSENTIAL TRAVEL

Avoid non-essential travel to Saudi Arabia due to the volatile security situation in the region.

King Khalid International Airport (RUH) and King Fahd International Airport (DMM) - Avoid all travel

Avoid all travel to King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh and to King Fahd International Airport in Dammam due to ongoing military activity, which is disrupting airport operations.

 

Provinces of Asir, Jazan and Najran - Avoid all travel

Avoid all travel to the provinces of Asir, Jazan and Najran due to the risk of armed strikes, drone attacks and military debris from interception.

 

Border with Yemen - Avoid all travel

Avoid all travel to areas within 30 km of the border with Yemen, due to the ongoing armed conflict in Yemen and the risk of violent clashes and spillovers across the border.
